plan_review.notes: Adversarial plan review (gpt-5.5) red-teamed the design and enumerated alternatives per decision: 9-slice vs cover-fit vs contain-fit for no-stretch; feet vs pixel vs tile-count sizing; fail-open vs fail-closed ledger load; asset_findings-only vs cross-array suppression; auto-inferred vs curated aliases; treat-any-placeholder-as-not-ready vs expected-count. Verdict: approved_with_changes. 2 BLOCKING concerns, both resolved in 2d234795: P1 (queued-asset suppression only covered asset_findings, so a ledgered defect was re-critiqued via blocking_findings/recommended_fixes/precise_fixes -> fixed with cross-array token-boundary suppression, deterministic blockers exempt) and P2 (ledger load failed OPEN on a corrupt file, silently returning an empty suppress-list -> fixed to fail-closed: throw on corrupt, tolerate only ENOENT). Non-blocking, DEFERRED as follow-ups (not counted as gating concerns): P5 deterministic sconce-on-wall invariant test (valuable, larger, out of the user's stated 2-blocking scope), plus minor P3/P4/P6 doc/naming notes. plan_divergence=minor: hardening + a test were added, no re-architecture.
